Delivering high-fidelity VR and AR experiences to enterprise users has typically required native application development, custom device management, and complex deployment pipelines. Now, with the new JavaScript SDK NVIDIA CloudXR.js, developers can stream GPU-rendered immersive content directly to a standard web browser—no app store, no installs, no device-specific builds.
